final: WITH player_groups AS (SELECT pa.player_id, p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON pa.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), hand_totals AS (SELECT batting_hand, SUM(n) AS total FROM player_groups GROUP BY batting_hand), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall_total FROM hand_totals), shares AS (SELECT h.batting_hand, h.total, 1.0 * h.total / o.overall_total AS share FROM hand_totals AS h JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.batting_hand, s.total, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
